chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Concerning a man who owned a slave belonging to him, and the slave asked his master for mukataba: is he allowed not to enter into the mukataba with him except at a high price? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.الْغَلَاءِ: a high price or costly amount
key_terms.الْمُكَاتَبَةَ: a manumission contract in which the slave purchases freedom through agreed payments
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative legal response meaning yes

ai.seo_question: Can a master set a high price in a mukataba contract?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding mukataba, a contract by which a slave seeks emancipation in exchange for payment. Imam عليه السلام states that the master may stipulate a high price in such an agreement.
